strokes.text: Manages one image source, with typed attributes for its file, and its first placement in a scene.
It is the typed form of @resources/source for the `image_source` kind: the provider checks the file before it writes.
Import by collection name, source UUID, anchor scene UUID and anchor scene item ID, separated by pipe characters:

glazes.name: Name of the source as shown in OBS. Changing it replaces the resource.
